# pcd_networking_qos_minimum_bandwidth_rule (Resource)

Manages a minimum-bandwidth (guaranteed) rule on a Neutron QoS policy in PCD.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_qos_policy" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-qos"
}

resource "pcd_networking_qos_minimum_bandwidth_rule" "example" {
  qos_policy_id = pcd_networking_qos_policy.example.id
  min_kbps      = 1000
  direction     = "egress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `min_kbps` (Number) The minimum guaranteed bandwidth in kbps.
- `qos_policy_id` (String) The QoS policy this rule belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `direction` (String) The traffic direction: egress (default) or ingress.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_qos_minimum_bandwidth_rule.example <qos_policy_id>/<rule_id>
```
